criteria.description: The DB-core scope, authority, transaction boundaries and the CVG-002B2 HTTP/provider boundary are explicit and non-overlapping.
criteria.limitations: This gate authorizes only the direct tenant-UoW confirmed-PIX DB core in a disposable environment; signed callback, freshness, external replay, worker restart, outbound dispatch, real providers, card, inventory, browser E2E and production remain outside it.

criteria.description: The failure-first sequence, lock model, failpoints and provider-scoped idempotency are executable without a network call inside the PostgreSQL transaction.
criteria.limitations: The clarification does not grant behavioral acceptance; focused PostgreSQL/RLS, concurrency, failpoint and regression evidence plus independent re-review are still required.

criteria.description: The original HTTP wording is corrected without weakening the overall CVG-002B acceptance surface; the deferred boundary remains mandatory in CVG-002B2.
criteria.limitations: No B1 evidence may be cited as proof of an HTTP callback, signature verification, provider dispatch, consumer wiring or crash recovery across callback and worker.

authority.decision: Authorize continued reversible repository implementation and disposable PostgreSQL/provider simulation for the clarified CVG-002B1 DB core; CVG-002B2, production, credentials, external mutation and release remain excluded.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before CVG-002B2, outbound provider mutation, real credentials, production deployment, irreversible migration or release acceptance.

next_action: Complete negative and failpoint coverage for the direct confirmed-PIX DB core, then run regression and independent re-review.
revalidation_triggers: CVG-002B1 DB-core scope or acceptance changes
A test disproves the transaction, lock or provider-scoped idempotency model
A HIGH/CRITICAL risk cannot be controlled within the bounded command
HTTP callback, worker integration, outbound provider calls, real credentials, production or irreversible data mutation enter scope
